comment: Recorded demo orders for the staff Orders admin (phase 1 of the admin-commerce plan).
SHAPE: each record WRAPS the FROZEN order-payment-api-v1 envelope (`order`, exactly the
docs/08-delivery/contracts/order-payment-api-v1.md response shape — number, status,
customer_name, total_cents, currency, items, placed_at, event_uuid) with fields the frozen
contract does not carry and the admin needs: the customer's checkout contact details
(`customer`) and an APP-AUTHORED fulfilment lifecycle (`lifecycle_status` + `timeline`).
NO frozen contract names an order-admin record — this wrapper is a fixture/demo shape
(same status as lib/fixtures/property/purchase-applications.json), to be replaced when a
service contract freezes an order-admin surface. The admin write route answers 503 in live
mode rather than inventing one (lib/api-client/order-store.ts).
LIFECYCLE vs FROZEN STATUS: `lifecycle_status` (new → confirmed → fulfilled, or cancelled)
is the counter's fulfilment decision; it never rewrites the frozen payment `status`
(all rows settled `paid` via the M0 sandbox adapter). Phase 1 does no payment processing,
so cancelling an order here closes the fulfilment, not a refund.
PRICES: every line carries a real catalogue SKU from commerce/catalog-items.json
(which transcribes the client's 2026 sheets via lib/villa-pricing.ts) with that item's
unit_price_cents; totals are the sum of the lines. tests/fixture-contract/orders.test.ts
pins SKUs, prices and totals against the catalogue.
WITHDRAWN SKUs (2026-09-18): the demo orders used to sell SRV-LIGHTS, ADD-COFFIN-LIZO-SR,
ADD-FLOWERS and ADD-URN — the four upstream items no 2026 client sheet prices. Those
lines were replaced with real client-sourced lines (see lib/catalog-sources.ts) so the
order admin never publishes an invented figure either; each affected order's total was
re-summed and its billing invoice (lib/fixtures/finance/invoices.json) follows.
BILLING COHERENCE: the order numbers, customers and totals line up with the billing
fixture's invoices (lib/fixtures/finance/invoices.json) — e.g. ORD-2026-00001 /
INV-2026-00001 / Marites Santos / ₱63,520.00 — so a demo session can follow one order
from the storefront into billing without meeting two different stories.
DEMO DATA ONLY: names, emails and phone numbers are invented .test placeholders.
CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the recorded demo records are REMOVED. The office's reference data is kept; a record is written only when the office actually records one.
